title: Verification codes
intro: What the external API returns, and what to do with it. Each row pairs a return code with a public-page behaviour; until the API is enabled, these codes also drive the local registry.
saveError: Save refused — the catalogue needs at least one “valid” code, and distinct values.
loadError: Catalogue unreadable — restore the defaults if needed.
footnote: A code returned by the API but missing here is never defaulted to “valid”: the public page reports the anomaly and the administrator adds the row. Saving replaces the whole catalogue.
